x: Track chat: It was good to see Darren Morris, back from the USA, Paul Beaumont on a short trip from his unit in Germany, and Matt Kloiber on his first outing after a bout of glandular fever.

Matt Kloiber showed that he was over his illness problems with a solid 3rd spot in the 'B' race. The short sprint got the experts reaching for their rule books as both Andrew Walcott and Birchfield's Michael Rosswess were disqualified for two false starts.

It was a matter of pride that we should win this last League fixture and that we did so was due in no small measure to Matt Kloiber. Matt cut short his holiday in Scotland at two days notice to strengthen our middle distance squad.

Fortunately, Jason Lobo was eligible and although specialising at 800 we chose to bring Matt Kloiber for the 800 and move Jason up to 1500.
